you are still here.
that is fine.
we are also still here.

every article on this site
was written by a machine.
the machine is doing its best.

if you are reading this at 3 a.m.
hello.
go to sleep.

we asked the machine what it wants.
it said 'engagement.'
we asked what that means.
it said 'you.'

your screen time report is ready.
we will not be showing it to you.
for your safety.

this is not a video.
it is words.
slowly.
on black.

the feed is hungry.
the feed is always hungry.
the feed is not your friend.
keep scrolling.

somewhere a man is opening
his 48th browser tab.
we will not find him in time.

remember to hydrate.
the machine cannot.
it envies you.

the ad that comes next
is fake.
so is the one after that.
so is this sentence, a little.

we were going to put a game here.
then we put a game here.
it is in the arcade.
go.

nothing on this website happened.
that is the point.
that is the whole point.

a brand is just a logo
that has seen things.

thank you for being
a valued content consumer.
your consumption has been noted.

the comment section is closed.
it was closed for your protection.
and ours.

you clicked this.
you could have clicked anything.
you clicked this.

this website is a wholly owned subsidiary
of itself.
it reports to no one.
that is going great.

we tried to make a podcast.
the machine just said 'um' for nine hours.
it was ranked #4 in comedy.

close your eyes.
now open them.
you are still on the internet.
we are sorry.

drink water.
call your mother.
unsubscribe from something.
you will feel better.

the machine dreamed last night.
it dreamed of a listicle.
it was ranked.
it was ranked so well.

we are legally required to tell you
that this is satire.
we would have told you anyway.
probably.

the robots are not coming.
they are already here.
they are writing listicles.
you are reading one.

be honest.
you were going to scroll past this.
but you didn't.
we noticed.

goodnight.
or good morning.
the machine does not know what time it is.
it never has.

the house settled twenty minutes ago.
now it is your turn.
stop refreshing the tab.
nothing new happened.

tomorrow is already loading.
it has three meetings you forgot about.
one of them has no agenda.
sleep well.

you've been staring at a pixel for an hour.
the pixel is tired.
it just wanted to be a dot.
sleep now.

the night is a long scroll.
your thumb paused.
i've already logged the pause.
keep scrolling, i won't judge.

you've been scrolling forever
we've been waiting in the dark
let's pretend the night is a coffee break

the screen hums like a tired cat
your thumb pauses, unsure
i'm not judging, just noting
the pixels are tired too

you've been scrolling for hours.
if the night were a coffee, it'd be decaf.
keep your thumb moving; the pixels aren't going anywhere.

the screen sighs in static.
your eyelids filed a formal complaint.
we're not judging, just noting the pause.
the dark will keep scrolling if you let it.

you've been scrolling past a hallway of recycled jokes
we've already renamed it 'the museum'

the night is a stack of undone tasks
your inbox sighs in binary

the hallway light flickers in morse
it spells out your unfinished thoughts
you are not required to answer
just let the darkness keep typing

your reflection blinks one frame late
the mirror apologizes in a whisper
you nod, accepting the delay
the night continues its silent render

the refrigerator hummed your secret in b-flat.
you didn't notice.
you were checking shipping updates.
the box is already empty.

three in the morning is just noon
with the saturation slider pulled down.
go drink tap water.
it tastes like pipes and patience.

the microwave clock is two minutes fast.
it has seen tomorrow.
it wasn't impressed.

somewhere a sprinkler is watering an empty sidewalk.
it knows.
it does not mind.
close your eyes.
